project.name: Windygates
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 13 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Wellsgreen is explicitly related context outside the strict village boundary and contributes no town-rating points. Its full restaurant is not used to pad the café-led Eat category. Leven attractions and facilities are not transferred.
